notes.title: Toing's Pops 2's Future
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody, with Toing's Pops 2 becoming free today, I thought I'd give an update on some things I'm considering. With Seven Days Until Morning finished development and coming out on TUESDAY!!! I've been considering doing some updates to Toing's Pops 2 (and maybe 1). These very likely doesn't mean new content for Toing's Pops 2, but instead updates towards optimization, lighting, and UI.

My biggest focus for this would be optimization, because to be honest, the game's performance struggles. Also the settings are terrible. Second, the lighting's a bit broken, specifically on Enceladus. The UI could also use a bit of work too. My main focus is ultimately the optimization however.

Just thought I'd give a little update on it, I can't say that this is a for sure thing, but It's something I've worked a bit on.[/p]

notes.title: Toing's Pops 2 Becomes Free June 27th
notes.content: [p]Hey everybody, I just wanted to give a heads up that Toing's Pops 2 will become free on Friday, June 27th. Considering the game is 99 cents already, I think it's just best to have it be free![/p]

notes.title: Toing's Pops 2 Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update includes balancing, bug fixes, and performance increases.

Balancing:
[list]
[*][b]Kerberos[/b]
- If killed in phase one or two, you will get teleported to the portal.

[b]Projection of Chardonnay[/b]
- Increased damage dealt without supercharged (previously 3, now 4.5)
   I might increase this even more in the future, but I felt like the difference between non supercharged 
   and supercharged was way too much.
- Reduced damage taken by Chardonnay's tracking rounds (previously dealt 10 damage per hit, now 
   does 7)
     I changed this because having to sit around getting your health back for a long time doesn't seem 
     too fun.

[b]Performance:[/b]
- Enceladus performed seriously badly, and performed especially badly on hardware without hardware ray tracing. 
    I feel super dumb having left on hardware ray tracing, and ray tracing in general. I turned it on and 
    never noticed because I have a higher end card with hardware ray tracing, so I was never able to 
    notice this.
    The lighting as a whole in Toing's Pops 2 has been slightly tweaked, but shouldn't look super 
    different. Performance as a whole however should be significantly better. If it isn't please let me 
    know, and also what specs your PC has.
[/list]
